name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the connection for display and reference, must be unique

maxConnectionLimit.title: Max Connection Limit
maxConnectionLimit.description: The maximum number of concurrent database connections allowed. If set to 0 then there is no limit on the number of open connections. -1 to leave unset and use system default.

maxOpenDuration.title: Max Open Duration
maxOpenDuration.description: The maximum amount of time a connection may be reused. Expired connections may be closed lazily before reuse. Ex: 1s, 1m, 500ms. Empty to leave unset.

maxIdleLimit.title: Max Idle Limit
maxIdleLimit.description: The maximum number of idle database connections allowed. If set to 0 then there is no limit on the number of idle connections. -1 to leave unset and use system default.

maxIdleDuration.title: Max Idle Duration
maxIdleDuration.description: The maximum amount of time a connection may be idle. Expired connections may be closed lazily before reuse. Ex: 1s, 1m, 500ms. Empty to leave unset.

rootCert.title: Root Certificate
rootCert.description: The public key certificate of the CA that issued the server's certificate. Root certificates are used to authenticate the server to the client. They ensure that the server the client is connecting to is trusted.

clientCert.title: Client Certificate
clientCert.description: A public key certificate issued to the client by a trusted Certificate Authority (CA).

clientKey.title: Client Key
clientKey.description: A private key corresponding to the client certificate. The client key is used to authenticate the client to the server.

serverName.title: Server Name
serverName.description: Server Name is used to verify the hostname on the returned certificates. It is also included in the client's handshake to support virtual hosting unless it is an IP address. This is only required if performing full tls verification.

host.title: Host
host.description: The hostname of the bastion host that will be used for SSH tunneling.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port of the bastion host.

user.title: User
user.description: The name of the user that will be used to authenticate. If using passphrase auth, provide that in the appropriate field below.

privateKey.title: Private Key
privateKey.description: The private key for the bastion host. If using passphrase auth, provide that in the appropriate field below.

passphrase.title: Passphrase / Private Key Password
passphrase.description: The passphrase that will be used to authenticate with. If the SSH Key provided above is encrypted, provide the password for it here.

knownHostPublicKey.title: Known Host Public Key
knownHostPublicKey.description: The public key of the bastion host. This should be in the format like what is found in the `~/.ssh/known_hosts` file, excluding the hostname. If this is not provided, any host public key will be accepted.

shared.ifTrueTheSdk: If true, the SDK will use the EC2 role assigned to the instance

clientTls.title: Client TLS Certificates
clientTls.description: Configuring this section allows Husonym to connect to the database using SSL/TLS.

sshTunnel.title: SSH Tunnel
sshTunnel.description: This section is optional and only necessary if your database is not publicly accessible to the internet.

shared.sshTunnelError: Unable to connect to SSH tunnel

awsAdvanced.title: AWS Advanced Configuration
awsAdvanced.description: This is an optional section and is used if you need to tweak the AWS SDK to connect to a different region or endpoint other than the default.

envVar.title: Environment Variable
envVar.description: The environment variable that contains the connection URL. Must start with "USER_DEFINED_". Must be present on both the backend and the worker processes for full functionality.

protocol.title: Connection Protocol
protocol.description: The protocol to use for the connection

sslMode.title: SSL Mode
sslMode.description: Turn on SSL Mode to use TLS for client/server encryption.

pathPrefix.title: Path Prefix
pathPrefix.description: The path prefix for the bucket

serviceAccountCredentials.title: Service Account Key
serviceAccountCredentials.description: The JSON key file of the service account the connection acts with. Without one, the connection acts with the identity of the servers running Husonym, which the deployment must allow.

fields.theUrlOfThe: The url of the OpenAI API (or equivalent) server
fields.theApiKeyFor: The API key for the OpenAI API (or equivalent) server

min.label: Minimum Length
min.description: Set the minimum length range of the output phone number. It cannot be less than 9.

max.label: Maximum Length
max.description: Set the maximum length range of the output phone number. It cannot be greater than 15.

randomizeSign.label: Randomize Sign
randomizeSign.description: Will randomly assign the sign. This may cause the generated value to be out of the defined min/max range. If the min/max is 20-40, the value may be in the following ranges: 20 <= x <= 40 and -40 <= x <= -20

min.label: Minimum Value
min.description: Sets a minimum range for generated float64 value.

max.label: Maximum Value
max.description: Sets a maximum range for generated float64 value.

precision.label: Precision
precision.description: Sets the precision for the entire float64 value, not just the decimals. For example. a precision of 4 would update a float64 value of 23.567 to 23.56.

abbreviate.label: Abbreviate
abbreviate.description: Abbreviate the gender to a single character. For example, female would be returned as f.

randomizeSign.label: Randomize Sign
randomizeSign.description: Will randomly assign the sign. This may cause the generated value to be out of the defined min/max range. If the min/max is 20-40, the value may be in the following ranges: 20 <= x <= 40 and -40 <= x <= -20

min.label: Minimum Value
min.description: Sets a minimum range for generated int64 value.

max.label: Maximum Value
max.description: Sets a maximum range for generated int64 value.

min.label: Minimum Length
min.description: Set the minimum length range of the output string.

max.label: Maximum Length

generateFullName.label: Generate Full Name
generateFullName.description: Enable to return the full state name with a capitalized first letter. Returns the 2-letter state code by default.

includeHyphens.label: Include hyphens
includeHyphens.description: Set to true to include hyphens in the generated UUID. Note: some databases such as Postgres automatically convert UUIDs with no hyphens to have hyphens when they store the data.

preserveLength.label: Preserve Length
preserveLength.description: Set the length of the output e164 phone number to be the same as the input e164 phone number.

preserveLength.label: Preserve Length
preserveLength.description: Set the length of the output email to be the same as the input

preserveDomain.label: Preserve Domain
preserveDomain.description: Preserve the input domain including top level domain to the output value. For ex. if the input is john@gmail.com, the output will be ij23o@gmail.com

excludedDomains.label: Excluded Domains
excludedDomains.description: Provide a list of comma-separated domains that you want to be excluded from the transformer. Do not provide an @ with the domains.

emailType.label: Email Type
emailType.description: Configure the email type that will be used during transformation.

invalidEmailAction.label: Invalid Email Action
invalidEmailAction.description: Configure the invalid email action that will be run in the event the system encounters an email that does not conform to RFC 5322.

emailType.label: Email Type
emailType.description: Select the type of email you want to generate. Uuid_v4 emails guarantee uniqueness.

preserveLength.label: Preserve Length
preserveLength.description: Set the length of the output first name to be the same as the input

randomizationRangeMin.label: Relative Minimum Range Value
randomizationRangeMin.description: Sets a relative minimum lower range value. This will create a lowerbound around the source input value. For example, if the input value is 10, and you set this value to 5, then the minimum range will be 5 (10 - 5 = 5).

randomizationRangeMax.label: Relative Maximum Range Value
randomizationRangeMax.description: Sets a relative maximum upper range value. This will create an upperbound around the source input value. For example, if the input value is 10, and you set this value to 5, then the maximum range will be 15 (10 + 5 = 15).

preserveLength.label: Preserve Length
preserveLength.description: Generates a full name which has the same first name and last name length as the input first and last names

randomizationRangeMin.description: Sets a relative minimum lower range value. This will create a lowerbound around the source input value. For example, if the input value is 10, and you set this value to 5, then the minimum range will be 5 (10 - 5 = 5).

randomizationRangeMax.label: Relative Maximum Range Value
randomizationRangeMax.description: Sets a relative maximum upper range value. This will create an upperbound around the source input value. For example, if the input value is 10, and you set this value to 5, then the maximum range will be 15 (10 + 5 = 15).

preserveFormat.label: Preserve Format
preserveFormat.description: Keep the prefix (06, +33 6), separators and length of the input, and replace the other digits. Two distinct numbers never give the same output, and the same number always gives the same one.

preserveLength.description: Set the length of the output phone number to be the same as the input. Implied by Preserve Format.

preserveLength.description: Set the length of the output string to be the same as the input

generateFullName.label: Generate Full Name
generateFullName.description: Enable to return the full country name otherwise it returns the 2-letter country code by default.

ipType.label: IP Version
ipType.description: Select if you want to generate an IPv4 or IPv6 address.

code.regexDescription: Provide a Go regular expression to match and transform a substring of the value. Leave this blank to transform the entire value. Note: the regex needs to compile in Go.
code.generateDescription: Define your own Transformation below using Javascript
code.transformDescription: Define your own Transformation below using Javascript. The source column value will be available at the value keyword. While additional columns can be accessed at input.'{'column_name'}'.
code.globalWritesTitle: This code writes outside its own variables
code.globalWritesDescription: That state only lives for one row: it is shared with the other columns of the row, and lost at the next one. To turn the same value into the same output, use the pseudo.* functions (Athanor).
code.trialInvalidJson: The rows are not valid JSON: {error}
code.trialNotArray: The rows must be an array of JSON objects.
code.trialDescription: The rule runs on the rows below as it would in an Athanor job: its state does not carry from one row to the next. The pseudo.* functions derive here from a key drawn for the trial, so their outputs have the shape of a run's, not its values.
